work.description: The instrument’s full territorial dismemberments, vicariate constitution, named execution duties, provisory government, transumpt, Nulli ergo and dating clause survive. Source citation8798 is XXI’s provenance despite preceding its heading. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS EPISCOPUS at LF8830–8830; the source closing at LF9082–9085 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die secunda iunii millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo pontificatus No- stri anno decimo..  Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
